Clay Jenkins

Democratic candidate for Dallas County Judge, Dallas County, Texas · Incumbent

Dallas County Judge; attorney

First elected in 2010 and seeking a fifth term. Voted in August to put the county's homelessness tax rate increase (Proposition A) on the ballot.
